posts.title_kr: 쿠키런 크럼블 전투력 가장 빨리 올리는 방법은?? 이거보고 따라해보세요
posts.title_en: ND러너: the fastest way to raise power
posts.summary_en: Higher power means a better stage correction, so power has no downside. The two big levers are gear (plating, oven level for gear level) and Stellar Link; Stellar points open only with cookie promotion (pet stars don't count), so don't skip pickups. Lower-rarity gear with a higher level can show more power. Team composition changes power: attack-type cookies carry high power, healers, tanks and supports low, so swapping Cheesecake for Cream Puff raised team power. Resolve (coins) matters a lot; hoarding coin chests while stuck is self-defeating. Fame from Arena medals grows into a gap that 'can't be caught up'. Fastest for spenders: key packages (daily dungeon keys feed oven, coins, EXP, runes at once); for F2P the same keys from mileage.

datapoints.after: Cream Puff in team: higher team power
datapoints.note: shown on screen, no figures in subtitles

advice.text: Stellar and gear are the two big power levers.
Key packages are the fastest paid growth; F2P buys keys with mileage.
Keep Fame up via Arena; the gap compounds.

quotes.kr: 크게 높이는 방법은 장비의 스펙을 확 높이는 방법 … 또 다른 방법은 바로 이 스텔라 컨텐츠
quotes.en: The big ways are raising gear spec … and the Stellar content

quotes.kr: 마법형, 사격형, 폭발형 뭐 이런 공격적인 전투유형은 기본적으로 전투력이 엄청나게 좀 높아요. 반면에 힐러, 탱커, 지원 이런 애들은 전투력 자체가 좀 낮습니다
quotes.en: Attack-type cookies have high power by default; healers, tanks and supports have low power

quotes.kr: 열쇠 패키지가 왜 제일 빠르냐
quotes.en: Why the key package is the fastest

posts.title_kr: 쿠키런 크럼블 뉴비만 모르는 "전투력 보정" 시스템?? 스테이지 돌파 팁정리 이건 꼭 알고하세요
posts.summary_en: Demonstration: Wind Archer alone hits for 1,068; adding healers who give no buffs raises team power and multiplies her damage. Fastest power: spend banked coin chests on Resolve, a bit at a time (the chests scale with the current stage); Stellar can spike power; Implant Tower rewards; Arena → Fame (boss, element, crit damage and power); gear and Stellar are the two biggest levers, then Resolve. Paid: Ad Removal, research-attached memberships, Crumble Pass for the daily dungeon +1, the Unique gear pack, then 3.3/5.5. Stellar targets by spend: F2P 70%, light 80s, mid low 90s, whale 96. Don't pull pets for Stellar; only cookie promotion counts.

datapoints.after: several times that after adding healers

advice.text: Open coin chests gradually, as far into the stages as possible.
Stellar targets: F2P 70%, light 80s, mid low 90s, whale 96.

quotes.kr: 무과금은 그냥 70% 만족. 소가금은 80 후반. 중가금은 제가 볼 때는 그냥 90초. 핵과금은 96
quotes.en: F2P: 70% is enough. Light spenders high 80s. Mid spenders low 90s. Whales 96

quotes.kr: 제가 볼 때는 가장 크게 영향 미치는 요소 중에 하나가 장비 스텔라
quotes.en: The biggest factors are gear and Stellar

posts.title_kr: 쿠키런 크럼블 초스피드 계정 성장법 초반부터 "가장 빠른 성장" 꼭 알고가세요
posts.summary_en: Plating: all to 5, all to 10, then 15 starting with the bow (accuracy). Fame raises power like other stats and adds boss/element/crit damage. Total account power means little; the team power shown on the lineup is what the stage correction uses (Wind Archer 192 → 576 per hit after adding a healer). Daily dungeon floors matter enormously: a low-floor key gives 64, a high-floor key 6,000; key count grows with the Crumble Pass and research packages. Stellar: F2P stop at 70% on early constellations and save for later ones (15% there vs much more later). Pull pickups to at least 5★ for Stellar points; in exchanges buy Stellar Points first (no other source), Tea Knight from the guild shop.

advice.text: All plates to 5, then 10, then bow to 15 first.
F2P: 70% early, spend on later constellations.

quotes.kr: 총 전투력은 제가 볼 때 뭐 그렇게 큰 의미가 없어요
quotes.en: Total power doesn't mean much

quotes.kr: 낮은 층에서 64개죠? … 열스 하나당 몇 개까지 되냐면 6,000개가 됩니다
quotes.en: 64 per key on a low floor … up to 6,000 per key higher up

posts.title_kr: 쿠키런 크럼블 "쿠키 경험치와 레벨" 의 다양한 기능 알고가세요. 100레벨 우선순위 누구부터 찍을까??
posts.title_en: ND러너: cookie EXP and level priority
posts.summary_en: Late game EXP (별사탕) runs short, so not every cookie can be 100. Stage priority: Milk first (captain, heals and buffs by ATK), then the damage dealers, then the healer (Herb), the rest evenly; Pomegranate can sit lowest if it survives. Levels also set Crumble Dungeon order (top 40 by power) and let Milk be the highest-ATK target for Passion Pay.

advice.text: Level Milk first, then dealers, healer, rest; Pomegranate lowest.

quotes.kr: 제일 1순위는 누구냐? 우유마 쿠키가 1순위입니다
quotes.en: First priority is Milk Cookie

posts.title_kr: 쿠키런 크럼블 노움연구소 "쿠키 능력" "특별 연구" 연구 순서 총정리
posts.summary_en: Take one step per node upward for the special research (Sugar Flame from dismantling first, the dice), but the newest nodes cost 1.6M research stones, so stones become the limit. Defense adds little power; HP adds the most power of ATK/DEF/HP and helps survival. Plates: all to 10, then bow and ring to 15, then sword or book, then armor/DR. Stellar gives the most power, and later constellations amplify far more at the same % (at 96%: constellation 1 19.2% ATK amp, 2 22.8%, 3 38.4%), so F2P should not over-invest early.

advice.text: HP nodes for power and survival; defense last.

quotes.kr: 체력 올릴 때 엄청 많이 올라가요 … 전투력이 가장 많이 오릅니다
quotes.en: HP raises it the most … power rises most

quotes.kr: 전투력을 가장 많이 올려 주는 건 스텔라인데
quotes.en: What raises power most is Stellar

posts.title_kr: [쿠키런크럼블] 혹시 연구 차례대로 만렙하고 계신가요? 그러면 손해보고 계신겁니다!
posts.summary_en: Research stones come mainly from the research stone dungeon. Take one step per node to reach the special research (the dismantle Sugar Flame bonus speeds oven levels); the lab is where the recommended-power gap is closed, so research ATK, crit rate and especially HP (large power) before accuracy/focus/element; defense one step only. Guild help shortens timers.

advice.text: Power first: ATK, crit, HP; defense one step.

quotes.kr: 방어는 전투력을 별로 올려 주지 않지만 체력은 전투력을 많이 올려 주기 때문에
quotes.en: Defense barely raises power, HP raises it a lot

posts.title_kr: [ 쿠키런 크럼블 ] 돌파력이란 무엇인가? 올려야 되는 이유를 알려드립니다
posts.summary_en: Each Resolve level adds flat ATK/DEF (+1) or HP (+10) to every cookie on the account (before the 2026-08-13 change doubled it after level 101); a tier needs all three maxed. Coins come from idle rewards, the coin dungeon and coin auto-hunt chests, which are worth more when opened at a higher stage.

datapoints.after: +1 ATK / DEF, +10 HP per level to every cookie

advice.text: Open coin auto-hunt chests later, at a higher stage.

quotes.kr: 돌파를 올릴 때마다 내가 갖고 있는 전체 쿠키에 이 스탯이 올라가요
quotes.en: Each Resolve level raises the stat on every cookie you own

posts.title_kr: [쿠키런크럼블] 스텔라 링크 공략
posts.summary_en: Constellation 1's points open with cookie slots, later ones with the total of cookie stars; later constellations give more; work the highest fully opened one. Method: lock six consecutive numbers (cost rises per lock) with 5,000+ points in hand; F2P settle at 70%, then 80%, then 90%.

advice.text: Lock six consecutive numbers; hold 5,000+ SP before trying.

posts.title_kr: 쿠키런 크럼블 이게 진짜 가능하네요?? 스텔라 100% 완벽 그 자체..!!
posts.summary_en: Account review: accuracy before power when misses show; lower gear rarity with higher level is fine; plating order bow (accuracy) 15, then ring (focus), then skill amp; Arena is a Fame farm first; Stellar Points have no steady source; Tea Knight must be bought (its promotion counts toward Stellar points).

advice.text: Treat Arena as a Fame farm.

quotes.kr: 아레나는 진짜 그 용도로 이용해야 돼요
quotes.en: Use the Arena for exactly that (Fame)

posts.title_kr: 쿠키런 크럼블 "최악의 행동" 계정을 망치는 대참사 절대 하지마세요!! 꼭 알아야 할 팁 정보
posts.summary_en: Idle rewards accrue with the live lineup, so park a lineup that never loses a cookie. Premium gacha is a trap: miss a pickup and the chance is gone; later the only way to raise Stellar is cookie promotion, so pull pickups to 5★+. Guild medals: Chocosteel or Stellar first; mileage keys: oven (dough) first. Fame's small % per level adds up. Lab: one step per node upward.

advice.text: Pull pickups to at least 5★; promotions are the only late source of Stellar points.

quotes.kr: 특히 전투력은 이 스텔라 링크와 장비발로 올리는 거거든요
quotes.en: Power in particular comes from Stellar Link and gear

posts.title_kr: 쿠키런 크럼블 알면 도움 되는 필수 정보 9가지 꿀팁 모음
posts.summary_en: Gear rarity levels: Eternal from level 31, Legendary 25, Unique 16, Super Epic 11. Best-value purchases: Ad Removal and the level-10 oven Unique pack; key packs for mid spenders. Wind Archer package not worth it for light spenders. Pickups to 6–8★ for Stellar. Stellar targets: whale 96% (100% expected 400,000 points, not advised), mid low 90s, light 80, F2P 70. Mileage: keys first, oven dough foremost; exchanges: Stellar Points first.

advice.text: Ad Removal and the oven-10 Unique pack are the top value.

quotes.kr: 100% 도전은 기대값이 40만 개래요
quotes.en: Going for 100% has an expected cost of 400,000

posts.title_kr: [쿠키런크럼블] 현질 유저가 알려주는 추천 패키지 공략
posts.summary_en: Must-haves: Ad Removal (ad boxes interrupt fights) and the 6,000 KRW Unique pack at oven 10 (two tiers above what oven 10 drops; oven 16+ to draw yourself; without it stages 20s–30s get hard). Optional: Wind Archer 17,000 KRW for the card (5★ at 55,000); Cake Hound 1,500 KRW; Choco Drop pet 20,000 KRW (package-only). Stage pass tier 1 (1,500) and 2 (3,000) pay coins for Resolve. Stellar: 32,000 KRW pack for 80%+ everywhere, 79,000 KRW for 90%+; F2P stays at 70%.

datapoints.cost: Unique pack 6,000 KRW; Stellar 32,000 KRW (80%+) / 79,000 KRW (90%+)

advice.text: Ad Removal and the Unique pack; the rest by goal.

quotes.kr: 5븐 10레벨에 나오는 6,000원 유니크 패키지는 인권 패키지라고
quotes.en: The 6,000 KRW Unique package at oven 10 is called the human-rights package

quotes.kr: 80% 이상으로 두르고 싶으신 분들은 3.2만 원짜리 한 개의 90% 이상으로 두르고 싶으신 분들은 7.9만 원 한 개
quotes.en: For 80%+ everywhere one 32,000 KRW pack, for 90%+ one 79,000 KRW pack

posts.title_kr: [쿠키런크럼블] 열쇠 패키지 절대 구매하지 마세요!
posts.title_en: 서신우: don't buy key packs (while capped)
posts.summary_en: Key packs are good value because new floors pay first-clear and milestone rewards; when the daily dungeons are capped (370 at the time) keys only sweep, so wait for an expansion. Eternal gear (0.02% at oven 31) is needed past 248-30 (recommended 1.2G at the time).

advice.text: Buy key packs when new dungeon floors are open, not while capped.

posts.title_kr: 가성비충이 추천하는 과금과 할인 방법은?! [쿠키런 키우기 / 쿠키런 크럼블]
posts.summary_en: Two 'human-rights' packs: Ad Removal and the oven-10 Unique pack. Then: the 55,000 KRW research membership (daily pulls and growth items, lifetime daily dungeon +1), the Crumble Pass (dungeon +1 during the pass), the monthly memberships at 16,000% and 14,000% value. Optional: stage pass (1,500 / 3,000, gold for Resolve), key packs. Wind Archer 17,000 / 55,000; one copy comes free at blessing level 3 (reached with Ad Removal plus the 55,000 membership). King Choco Drop pet: 10★ +16% party HP, 20★ +20%, package only. Galaxy Store coupons cut 85,000 KRW of these to 63,500 (25.3%).

advice.text: Ad Removal and Unique pack; then 5.5 membership, Crumble Pass, monthly memberships.

quotes.kr: 평생 1일 던전 플러스 1이라는 미친 혜택
quotes.en: the crazy perk of +1 daily dungeon for life

posts.title_kr: [ 쿠키런 크럼블 ] 알고가면 좋은 쿠키런크럼블 과금 추천 및 과금효율 정리
posts.title_en: 김바보 TV: spending value at launch
posts.summary_en: Launch-day view: the blessing (축복) VIP level fills at roughly 10% of spend as points, about level 3 under 100,000 KRW, up to 12. Best value: Ad Removal, then the cheap tiered passes (level pass gives Lucky Dough for the oven).

posts.title_kr: 쿠키런 크럼블 - 교환소 구매 우선순위 정리! 이건 무조건 구매하세요!
posts.summary_en: Exchanges (victory medal, guild medal, mileage): Syrup Metal first (no other steady source; needed to 20), then Chocosteel (idle drops are fixed at one an hour, 24 a day, and there are 12 plates), then Rune Crystals and Stellar Points only with spare medals (runes come ~2,000+ a day from idle; Stellar's value drops near 100%).

datapoints.cost: free Chocosteel capped at 24/day from idle

advice.text: Exchanges: Syrup Metal > Chocosteel > Rune Crystals / Stellar.

quotes.kr: 하루 수급량은 24개로 딱 고정되어 있습니다
quotes.en: Daily supply is fixed at 24

posts.title_kr: [쿠키런 크럼블] 플레이트 장비 가이드: 강화 우선순위 및 옵션 프리셋 총정리
posts.summary_en: Plate order: sword, bow, staff; then magic object, book, necklace, ring; then the rest, in steps of 5. Stage preset: pure power; at stage 281 with only one accuracy and one focus line (976 / 953) no retries were needed after the easing.

advice.text: Weapons first, in steps of 5.

quotes.kr: 스테이지는 무조건 전투력
quotes.en: For stages, power every time

posts.title_kr: [쿠키런크럼블] 플레이트 강화 공략
posts.summary_en: Uses the new hot-deal Chocosteel package (for spenders). Syrup Metal per decline protection: 1 at 10→11, 2 at 12–15, 3 from 16; shatter mitigation 2 more. Plates amplify the main stat each level and sub-stats every 5. The last boss of the expanded stages was said to need 2G recommended (before the easing).

posts.title_kr: [쿠키런크럼블] 장비 15강 이후 강화 공략 (복구 포함)
posts.summary_en: After 1.4.002: protect declines with Syrup to 15; from 15, don't spend Syrup on shatter mitigation (it only halves the chance) — keep the restore cost in reserve instead, which is as cheap or cheaper; from about 18 the unmitigated shatter chance is 8%, where mitigation becomes reasonable. 328-30 recommended power was quoted as 6G (a slip for the 35% or 55% line).

advice.text: Don't pay shatter mitigation early past 15; keep Syrup for restores.

posts.title_kr: 쿠키런 크럼블 - 플레이트 강화 가이드! 주요 옵션과 추천 강화 순서!
posts.summary_en: Plating results: great success +2 (refunds part), success +1, maintain, decline -1 (from 10), shatter back to 10 (from 15, before 1.4.002). Syrup from 13–15; for F2P all to 15 then slowly on. 9→10 is the hard step.

posts.title_kr: 쿠키런 크럼블 서버 1위가 계정을 삭제한 이유
posts.title_en: 영래기: why the server #1 deleted the account
posts.summary_en: News explainer: launch 2026-07-30, 20 billion KRW revenue in a month; the 2026-08-27 update raised recommended power and cut quest rewards by up to 97% without a note (apology 08-28, partial fix 08-31); plating at 19→20 was success 2%, great success 0.1%, maintain 48.9%, decline 39%, shatter 10% (back to 10); the all-server #1 deleted the account and the publisher then promised plating, mileage shop, level and preset fixes.

posts.title_kr: 억대 과금 1위도 "계정 삭제"..쿠키런 크럼블에 무슨 일이 생겼나ㅣ게임뉴스
posts.title_en: 겜커스: a 100M-KRW spender deleted the account
posts.summary_en: Same story: an account said to have spent over 100 million KRW was deleted after the 08-27 reward cuts and plating shatters.

posts.title_kr: 쿠키런 크럼블 마일리지 교환 상점 대개편 만족하시나요??
posts.summary_en: The mileage shop revamp of 2026-09-17 adds many items, about 100,000 mileage a week (400,000 a month) to buy out; a new random premium gift box has 50 Chocosteel at 0.4%. Plating's shatter is the pain point.

posts.title_kr: 쿠키런 크럼블 소과금 패키지추천 깊카10만 이벤
posts.summary_en: Livestream. The Crystal shop is not worth buying; buy Ad Removal and every research-attached membership; key packages 'without asking' (a high-floor key gives 4,000); hot-time deals are good for mid spenders; select boxes are poor value; blessing 8 cost about 2,000,000 KRW on day one.

advice.text: Ad Removal, research memberships, key packages first.

quotes.kr: 열쇠가 들어간 패키지는 그까 묻지도 따지지도 않고 무조건 다 구매한다
quotes.en: Any package with keys: buy it without a second thought

posts.title_kr: 당신의 전투력은 거짓입니다 — CookieRun: Crumble 장비 & 강화 가이드
posts.title_en: F2P Sol (global, Korean dub): 'your power is a lie'
posts.summary_en: Global channel, Korean auto-translated track. Displayed power sums stats that don't matter for a given cookie (focus, accuracy, resistance, move speed inflate it); prioritise skill amp, skill haste, crit; plate everything to +5 first (+30% to sub-stats). The oven-10 Unique set cost about $4.3 in the global store.

posts.title_en: F2P Sol (global): Stop Wasting Gold! How to Power Up FAST
posts.summary_en: Global F2P view (English track): max levels, then pour gold into the Build (Resolve) tab — early each level gave about 1,000 power; don't hoard coin chests early; rush the Gnome lab main path; Fame from PvP; Stellar area; pull and raise pets for the collection; a synergy team at 614k beat a raw 649k; displayed power sums stats irrelevant to a cookie; most purchases were $0.99–$1.99 items.

advice.text: Global F2P: spend gold on Resolve rather than hoard.

quotes.en: Each level gave 1000 strength. This is simply absurd.
Synergy is simply better than raw combat power.
